com.sun.jmx.remote.internal

接口 IIOPProxy

  • 所有已知实现类:
    IIOPProxyImpl

    public interface IIOPProxy
    An interface to a subset of the RMI-IIOP and CORBA APIs to avoid a static dependencies on the types defined by these APIs.
